# PayRail — payments infrastructure for African merchants

PayRail gives merchants across West Africa one integration for cards, bank transfers and mobile
money, with next-day settlement in local currency. Founded in Lagos in 2022, PayRail serves more
than 4,000 merchants and processes payments in Nigeria, Ghana and Côte d'Ivoire.

## Products
- Checkout and payment links
- Settlement and reconciliation
- Merchant onboarding API
